name: Dynamic Metal Price Calculator
author: Aolo Software

sections.description:
Dynamic Metal Price Calculator enables store owners to:
* Set today’s gold and silver prices from a simple admin page.
* Add per-product metadata (metal type, base price, weight, wastage, making charge, markup).
* Automatically compute final product prices for simple and variable products.
* Integrate computed prices with WooCommerce so taxes and shipping work as configured.

Support

For support, bug reports or feature requests, contact Sheikh Abir Ali at Aolo Software: https://aolo.software/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Metal Prices” in the admin menu to set today’s metal rates.
  4. Edit products and set product-level fields under the ‘General’ tab.
sections.faq:
Will taxes and shipping be applied to computed prices?

Yes. The plugin sets product prices so WooCommerce handles taxes/shipping as usual.

Can I use sale prices?

If a manual sale price is present, the plugin will treat it as a base for the computed price (temporarily replacing base price during calculation). Otherwise the computed price is used.
